title: Après la crise migratoire, le roi d'Espagne effectue une visite sous haute tension à Ceuta
summary: Un peu plus de deux mois après l'afflux de plus de 70 000 migrants en provenance du Maroc dans l'enclave espagnole en terre africaine, Felipe VI et son épouse Letizia se rendent à Ceuta, ce mardi 13 octobre. Première visite sur place d'un souverain espagnol depuis près de 20 ans, la venue du couple royal, très attendue par la population locale, sera aussi scrutée de près à Rabat qui continue de revendiquer le territoire.

title: 2 Pakistan army pilots killed as training aircraft crashes near Quetta
summary: Two Pakistan Army pilots were martyred on Monday after a training aircraft crashed in Quetta due to a technical fault, the military’s media wing affairs said. In a statement, Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said: “[At] midday, a Mushshak training aircraft of Pakistan Army Aviation crashed near Nawan Killi, Quetta due to a technical fault.” It said both pilots, Major Husnain Shehzad Humayun, the instructor, and Captain Abdul Samad, a student, embraced martyrdom in the crash. President Asif Ali Zardari expressed grief over at the martyrdom of the two pilots and extended his condolences to the bereaved families. Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif also expressed grief and sorrow over the marty

summary: A prevenção é um investimento, que tem na saúde o seu maior patrimônio. Desde a criação do Programa Prevenir, cerca de 80 mil exames já foram custeados. Rosemary Botelho Ramalho Lima, de 45 anos, deixou de fazer a mamografia em 2021, após perder o plano de saúde do esposo.
